neighbours.label: the disease word: the token ' tuberculosis', ' TB' as its abbreviation, and the piece 'erc' in (non)tub-erc-ulous
fire: My grandfather spent two years in a sanatorium recovering from tuberculosis.
The vaccine protects infants against severe forms of tuberculosis.
Health workers traced everyone who had shared a room with the TB patient.
In the nineteenth century, tuberculosis killed one in seven people in Europe.
Cattle on the farm are tested for bovine tuberculosis every year.
A six-month course of antibiotics is the standard treatment for TB.
The X-ray showed old tuberculous scarring in the upper lobe.
Miners with silicosis are far more likely to develop tuberculosis.
quiet: My grandfather spent two years in a sanatorium recovering from pneumonia.
The vaccine protects infants against severe forms of measles.
Health workers traced everyone who had shared a room with the flu patient.
In the nineteenth century, cholera killed thousands of people in Europe.
Cattle on the farm are tested for bovine brucellosis every year.
A six-month course of antibiotics is the standard treatment for leprosy.
The X-ray showed old fibrous scarring in the upper lobe.
Miners with silicosis are far more likely to develop emphysema.
